purpose: Separately versioned optional M2M setup for MIR ↔ StegVerse. Source contract and failure cases may progress without withholding the primary capability assessment.

sections.title: MIR-to-Ste​gVerse ingress
sections.capability: Existing SDK builds a canonical identity-bound request; current generic Universal InTr source receives and binds declared source framework, original manifest/request hashes and route.
sections.limitation: MIR's authenticated live endpoint, exact external adapter operation and actual original resident ingress have not been verified for this experiment.
sections.verification: Present MIR-origin request at a sourced current endpoint; check actual authenticated original InTr disposition, exact original manifest hash and organization/Master Records closure.

sections.title: Current commit-time authority
sections.capability: StegCore/Interlock/InTr owns current admission. The native ESRL lease must carry original-request-bound expiry and current snapshot; consumer refuses expired/revoked/mismatched authorization.
sections.limitation: The existing SDK local diagnostic does not invoke this authority. A snapshot or permission claim alone cannot certify a current lease or independently establish native original runtime.
sections.verification: Test current valid authority ALLOW and revocation/expiration immediately before a second distinct attempt, with exact native receipt lineage and independent Master Records readback.

sections.title: StegVerse-to-MIR egress
sections.capability: Existing SDK return and Publisher source can bind original manifest, authorized export, exact-byte reviewer artifacts and a prepared return packet before the final InTr egress.
sections.limitation: PREPARED_NOT_TRANSPORTED is not actual Publisher delivery; no original MIR far-side acknowledgement or authenticated live destination has been verified in Experiment 3.
sections.verification: Retrieve original Publisher ingress, returned original bytes, SDK result binding, final governed egress and MIR endpoint receipt. Verify exact original request correlation and timestamps.

sections.title: Refusal, replay and gaps
sections.capability: Source contracts preserve separately typed correctable profile DENY, genuine InTr non-ALLOW and terminal FAIL_CLOSED; no automatic retry of a terminal attempted execution.
sections.limitation: Profile-level source DENY is not an authentic native InTr rejection; missing original private evidence remains UNKNOWN rather than a false fail or success.
sections.verification: Preserve actual first refusal with specific failed predicate, correct only source/profile defects under existing owner and distinguish genuinely new governed attempts from duplicate request replay.

required_runtime_evidence: original authenticated MIR ingress / exact endpoint
current original InTr verdict and live lease
exact original organization and same-transition Master Records custody
authorized final InTr egress + independent MIR-side receipt
